peptide_bioactivity.verification: Full text (Elsevier PDF, institutional subscription, read 2026-10-01): Pacific cod (G. macrocephalus) skin from Jagalchi market, Busan; gelatin peptic hydrolysate <1 kDa, DEAE anion exchange and Superdex Peptide gel filtration (FI-1, purity checked by RP-HPLC); peptides identified by Q-TOF LC-MS/MS (Section 3.1, Fig. 2). HHL substrate (Sigma), rabbit-lung ACE (Section 2.3). Values are for the purified natural peptides; no synthetic peptide was assayed. Both sequences come from fraction FI-1 and the paper gives each its own IC50 (abstract, Section 3.1). Team-lead decision 2026-10-01 (verified-pilot-3.14): a sequence-confirmed purified single peptide counts like a synthetic one.
Same paper, fraction and assay as GASSGMPG; IC50 14.5 uM (abstract, Section 3.1).

Full text (RSC HTML, Dongguk institutional access, read 2026-10-01): R. philippinarum (Qingdao market) fermented with Bacillus natto; ultrafiltration <5 kDa, Sephadex G-10 (F4) and RP-HPLC (F4-C); four peptides identified by LC-MS/MS against a Bivalvia UniProt database and their IC50 values measured (Table 4, umol/L); the paper does not say whether synthetic or purified peptides were assayed. Cushman-Cheung, HHL 5 mM in 100 mM borate pH 8.3 with 300 mM NaCl, rabbit-lung ACE (Sigma) 0.1 U/mL, 37 C 60 min, 228 nm. Fermented origin accepted as for anchovy sauce (3.13). Team-lead decision 2026-10-01 (verified-pilot-3.14): a sequence-confirmed purified single peptide counts like a synthetic one.
